set.body: Implement the shared text contract in docs/plans/2026-10-27-graphics-resources.md through a real pinned HarfBuzz/FreeType service and immutable layout data usable by graphics and the eventual core adapter. First qualify artifact delivery, font identity/ownership and pointer-only shims under native gates; no source dependency build before disk check. Pin actual multilingual fonts and license/hash metadata. Reuse one shaping/layout result for metrics, glyph painting, hit/caret/selection geometry; do not independently reshape in renderer or add a synthetic passing fixture. Record blocking extern/thread behavior and evidence before claiming font or text support. Keep existing core/kernel semantics and concurrent work intact.
set.title: G-0/P0.3b: Pin font services and establish shared resolved text layout
